Overview.Name: Venkatesh Jujjuri
Overview.Goal: Feel energetic and confident with a simple, consistent vegetarian routine.

Early_Morning: Option 1: Warm water + plain milk (small cup)
Option 2: Warm water + small bowl curd
Meal_1_Main_Meal: Option 1: Plain rice (small portion) + dal + cooked vegetables
Option 2: Plain rice (small portion) + paneer curry + vegetables
Option 3: Plain rice (small portion) + curd + vegetable curry
Meal_2_Light_Dinner: Option 1: Paneer curry + small portion plain rice + vegetables
Option 2: Dal + small portion plain rice + cooked vegetables
Option 3: Vegetable curry + small portion plain rice + curd

Notes_and_Tips: All meals are strictly vegetarian with no eggs or non-veg.
Include paneer or dal regularly for adequate protein.
Keep rice portions small to maintain lightness and energy.
Avoid skipping meals even if appetite is low.
Yoga and regular meals support digestion and steady energy.
Focus on how the body feels rather than small weight changes.
